It only says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים" and that you pay tax if you take it out early, so I don't know what would be left.

stuck.why: A number shows up (25,725 at 4 years, 32,755 at 5), but it sits over an empty dashed box labelled 'אותו כסף בחשבון ...' and the round arrow button covers the rest of the label. I couldn't tell if that's my money in the fund or something else, while the orange text says there's no calculation for self-employed people.
No amount was given to me, so I kept the 500 ₪ a month and the 7% that were already filled in. I wasn't sure 7% is realistic.
